programs.title: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
programs.desc: In Glastonbury, Simon O'Brien makes a Flintstones-style table out of antique roof tiles, while Henry Cole fashions a quirky lamp out of traffic lights.

programs.desc: Anneli, the manager of a restored village in France, is having a tricky time with a wedding party. And we meet Mark, an estate agent who finds derelict villages in Galicia.

programs.desc: Sidhbh and Neasa launch their new Miami clinic with a party in an operating theatre. And Orlando wrestler D-Wayne contends with a bad knee.
